cases.description: A continuing artifact compacted into its next version with a self-replaces parent. Rejected and settled items keep their prior state, a term moved to the glossary becomes carried, and an ordinary removal stays dropped.
Two specs fold into C with replaces parents, then D supersedes C#D1 and C+D fold into E. A#D1 and C#D1 are both superseded by D#D1, while A#D2 and C#D2 are carried through to E.
